# Student execution projection V1

This additive internal read contract supplies Practice execution facts to the
Student-owned `NextActionResolver`. It preserves every public V2 wire field,
command, lifecycle invariant, and the frozen `practice-runtime-v2.md` digest.
Student owns the learner-wide primary action; Runtime owns these execution facts.

`GET /internal/v2/task-instances/{id}/execution-projection?student_id=<uuid>`
requires the Runtime `X-Internal-Token`. The dedicated Teacher token is rejected.
The instance lookup is scoped by the exact authenticated service-supplied student
and instance UUIDs. A different owner returns 404. Responses use `no-store`.

The response has schema `practice-execution-projection.v1` and these fields:

| Field | Semantics |
| --- | --- |
| `student_id`, `task_instance_id`, `learning_action_id` | Exact execution and learner association |
| `task_revision_id`, `task_revision_digest` | Exact immutable published revision binding |
| `learning_path_id`, `learning_path_item_id`, `requirement_id` | Optional exact stored Student correlation; no inferred identity |
| `status` | `READY`, `BLOCKED`, `COMPLETED`, or `CANCELLED` |
| `suggested_action` | One bounded execution suggestion, empty when no executable progression is available |
| `available_actions` | Ordered permitted execution actions; empty when blocked or terminal |
| `reason_code` | Deterministic machine-readable explanation |
| `version` | Opaque `sha256:` digest of the bounded snapshot and its local revisions |
| `step_id`, `milestone_id` | Optional first unfinished required milestone, skipping optional/completed/checkpointed steps |
| `submission_id` | Optional current official submission for result review |
| `submission_scope` | Optional `MILESTONE` or `FINAL` for the existing Submit command |

Student validates the echoed identities against its own authoritative LearningAction
and assignment before consuming the suggestion. There are no raw runtime enums,
validation stage reports, workspace identity/content, private criteria, or commands
that grant authority in this response.

| Execution condition | Projection |
| --- | --- |
| Provisioning | `BLOCKED`, `practice_provisioning` |
| Pending/running validation | `BLOCKED`, `validation_running` |
| Technical validation error | `BLOCKED`, `validation_error`; recovery remains internal, never learner failure/retry |
| Awaiting human review / finalization | `BLOCKED`, `human_review_pending` / `practice_finalizing` |
| Workspace unavailable | `BLOCKED`, `workspace_unavailable` |
| Next required milestone needs learning | `READY`, `START_PRACTICE_LEARNING`, `prerequisite_learning_required`, exact milestone target |
| Next milestone unavailable | `BLOCKED`, `milestone_unavailable` |
| Ready required milestone | `READY`, `RESUME_PRACTICE`, `practice_active`; `SUBMIT_PRACTICE` is secondary |
| All required milestones checkpointed/passed | `READY`, `SUBMIT_PRACTICE`, `final_submission_required`, scope `FINAL` |
| Learner validation failure / human changes requested | `READY`, `REVIEW_VALIDATION_RESULT`, `validation_result_failed` / `human_changes_requested`; `RETRY_PRACTICE` and otherwise permitted workspace/submit actions are secondary |
| Completion / cancellation | `COMPLETED` / `CANCELLED`, no executable action |

Runtime has no learner result-review acknowledgement entity. Review remains the
primary recommendation while that failed current result remains; learner retry
means returning to the same workspace and issuing the existing Submit command.
It never calls the technical ValidationRun recovery route. No new lifecycle is
introduced. A project always targets the concrete required milestone or final
submission, never a generic `CONTINUE_PROJECT`.

The immutable route can carry prerequisite material keys but does not persist
concrete Course/Lesson materialization identities. `START_PRACTICE_LEARNING` targets
the exact required step and permits the existing student-driven materialization
command, then learning/readiness reconciliation through their existing owners.
This read neither fabricates a lesson target nor performs materialization or
readiness reconciliation. Prerequisite learning is an actionable requirement,
not an indefinite waiting status.

The projection is computed and never persisted independently. Two complete
bounded reads must agree; transient changes are retried up to three times, then
return 409. The digest includes the instance revision plus current submission and
latest ValidationRun identity/status, including run changes that do not increment
the instance revision. Student combines this provenance with its own learner/path
revision. A projection is a snapshot decision, not a capability token. Existing
Submit, retry, human review, and completion commands re-read and enforce their
owner's authoritative invariants before execution. No read reserves, submits,
materializes, replans, applies evidence, or mutates a Learning Path.
